verdict.rationale: Recruitee supports building a candidate database/talent pools (docs-16, docs-29/42 'job or talent pool'), boolean search (docs-17), and in-app emailing with templates (docs-18, docs-19), which covers basic sourcing-CRM elements. However there's no evidence of personalized multi-step email sequences with open/click tracking or dedicated nurture campaign workflows for future roles. Missing for 10: sequence/drip-campaign builder, email open/click tracking, dedicated nurture-campaign automation for passive prospects.
